text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo's wailing echoes through the
academy
building. She's always been a
little dramatic... but
this sounds serious!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hic! Sniffle... I practiced Dash Tag lots and lots! But when I entered the tournament...

text_block_list.name: First Round Opponent
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I caught her in one minute flat. Git
gud, lol.
GG.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
And everyone made fun of me in the
comments,
too! Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's the word! It's infuriating! I'm so frustrated... I just can't accept this!
choice_data_list: That really makes you mad, doesn't it.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become the best in the
world... That'll
show them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A highly motivated Twin Turbo jumps
straight
into some training! She bolts
across the field!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She reads through a bunch of difficult
books!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she hones her body from dawn to
dusk!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I happen across a Dash
Tag
livestream on UmaTube with the
title "Taking on
Turbo."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The streamer appears to be a famous
gamer, but I
start watching with the
suspicion that I might see
a familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh! You've got guts challenging
the likes of
me!

text_block_list.name: Famous Game Streamer
text_block_list.text:
I've invited a special guest to the stream
for
today! Joining us as the runner is
Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Comment Section
text_block_list.text:
This is gonna be good. Hurry up and start!
Didn't Turbo get beat in the first
round last tournament?
She's the player
that got dunked on.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, just you watch! I'll show you the
results of
my special training!

text_block_list.name: Famous Game Streamer
text_block_list.text:
Heh, someone's raring to go! But I won't
be going easy
on you. This is a
no-holds-barred struggle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amid a swirl of intrigue, and with
countless viewers glued to their screens,
the two kick off a
game of Dash Tag!
However...

text_block_list.name: Comment Section
text_block_list.text:
Did she just head down that narrow path?
It's over. Turbo's got no chance.

She's already wasted her special move,
too.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ugh, there's nowhere to hide! Whyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Famous Game Streamer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Your defeat is only a matter of
time! I'm
about to unleash my
acceleration special move!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gah!
Br-bring it on! I can outrun you
easy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After taking a bad route right off the
jump, Twin Turbo has quickly exhausted
herself. The streamer
is slowly closing in
on her. But...

text_block_list.name: Famous Game Streamer
text_block_list.text:
Tch, I was so close... You're not too
shabby!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wheeze, wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Famous Game Streamer
text_block_list.text: You're a quick little runt!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... wheeze!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! Hehehehe!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Game over. The runner wins!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I... did it!

text_block_list.name: Comment Section
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I can't believe she got away!
I
thought she was mid, but she's got guts.

text_block_list.name: Famous Game Streamer
text_block_list.text: Man, this sucks! I nearly had you!

text_block_list.name: Famous Game Streamer
text_block_list.text:
...But I'm also glad. Now everyone's
gotten a taste
of your skills, Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: What're you talking ab—wait! Hang on...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That voice... Is it you, TSUBAME?! How
come
you're here?!

text_block_list.name: Famous Game Streamer
text_block_list.text:
I watched your match at the tourney...
And I
couldn't sit there doing nothing
after seeing a
friend humiliated like that!

text_block_list.name: Famous Game Streamer
text_block_list.text:
Well, this is the end of our game! Let's
play again
sometime, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Huh?! Wait a second! What's going on here?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...I got kicked out!
Wow, I had no clue
that TSUBAME was still
playing Dash
Tag.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, interesting!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win our next match, too, just
you wait!

text_block_list.name: Famous Game Streamer
text_block_list.text:
...Well, at least now everyone's gotten a
taste of your
skills, Turbo. I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Famous Game Streamer
text_block_list.text:
Well, gotta bounce. See you later,
Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wait, already?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I got kicked out! Wow, what a meanie!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
But I get the feeling I know that gamer
from
somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...Well, whatever!
